title: Machine learning finds metastasis and recurrence signatures in clear cell renal carcinoma
summary: Three machine-learning algorithms applied to eight ccRCC cohorts identified five metastasis-related signature genes (renin, ITGBL1, MXRA5, MEOX2, ANO3), which were checked in external and out-house cohorts. The signatures defined two subtypes, MTCS1 and MTCS2, with MTCS2 showing poorer outcomes and lower predicted response to immune blockade. MXRA5 suppressed migration and proliferation of ccRCC cell lines in vitro and in vivo.
